name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures an Nginx web server for three static HTTPS sites, including virtual hosts, self-signed TLS certificates, security headers, rate and size limits, Fail2Ban, UFW, SSH hardening, and kernel network hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis with authentication and logging, and applies a workaround for replication-related configuration settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a Python FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub, including its virtual environment, dependencies, local PostgreSQL database and credentials, environment configuration, and Uvicorn systemd service.
